findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] docker-compose.yml: no unneeded port mappings. web uses expose: 8091 (line 13-14) and db uses expose: 5432 (line 217-218), both intra-network only with no host publication. The single published mapping is proxy ports: '127.0.0.1:8443:8443' (line 130-131), bound to loopback rather than 0.0.0.0. The backend network is internal: true (line 225-226), so db is unreachable from the host regardless of later port edits. No how-tos on this CM, so Q2 skipped; Q3 alternative mitigation accepted - expose-over-publish plus a loopback-bound single ingress port delivers the same minimal-attack-surface property the runtime docker inspect port audit checks for. Marker scan clean | verdict=pass confidence=high
